role: Two lock-protected Sendable singletons bridging live recording state to the AI context: LiveWorkoutBroker (push snapshot per tick, at which point it also asks the recorder's samples provider for its buffer and keeps it, so readers on any thread get samples without touching main-actor state; 12 s staleness gate on the snapshot) and LiveHRVBroker (pull provider registered by RRCollector, which reads a lock-protected mirror).
types: LiveWorkoutBroker: class — holds latest LiveWorkoutSnapshot, its timestamp, the recorder's samples provider and the samples it returned at the last publish
LiveWorkoutBroker.State: struct — snapshot, lastUpdate, samplesProvider, samples
LiveHRVBroker: class — holds the RRCollector-installed provider closure for LiveHRVSnapshot
toplevel: Static singletons and lock initializers only.

units.does: Reads the samples provider under the lock, calls it outside the lock (publish runs on the recorder's main-actor tick, where the provider can read the buffer), then under the lock stores the snapshot, lastUpdate = now and the returned samples ([] with no provider).
calls: closure:SamplesProvider installed by WorkoutRecorder.installLiveWorkoutSamplesProvider (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift) returning recorder.samplesView on the main thread, [] elsewhere

branches.effect: no provider registered: keep empty samples

units.does: Under the lock, stores the recorder's samples-provider closure.

Under the lock, clears snapshot, lastUpdate, samples provider and the kept samples. Called only from the recorder's stop path; an aborted start leaves the provider registered until the next start, with no samples kept since nothing publishes.
Under the lock, returns the stored snapshot when it exists and was published within the last 12 s, else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil (no workout); true: check age

units.does: Returns, under the lock, the samples the provider returned at the last publish (at most one tick old); [] when no workout is publishing. Safe from any thread.
Stores the provider closure under the lock (replacing any previous one).
Reads the provider under the lock, then calls it outside, returning its LiveHRVSnapshot or nil when none registered/none active.
calls: closure:Provider installed by RRCollector.publishLiveHRVSnapshotsToAssistant (RRCollector+Bindings.swift:333) reading the collector's live HRV mirror
